answer.reason: Ai is the place where Israel was first defeated and then took the city by ambush and burned it.

clauses.english: routed Israel's first attack, killing about thirty-six men
clauses.quote: the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men

clauses.english: was taken by an ambush and burnt by Joshua into a heap for ever
clauses.quote: Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever

doubts: Genesis verses spell the name Hai and only place Abram's tent beside it, so they were left out.
The Ezra and Nehemiah verses only list the men of Bethel and Ai, so they were left out.
